location.parcel: Tax Map 94, Parcel 9; Quantum Frederick Lot 400 / Bauxite I

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction / approved-permitted as of 2026-08-11. Frederick County planning records show Bauxite Data Center / Lot 400 site-plan approvals and later Type 3 site-plan revisions; MDE confirmed Bauxite I construction activity on 2025-12-31 and issued a final air quality permit to Amazon Data Services, Inc. on 2026-03-25 for emergency backup generators at 3250 Digital Drive. Building permit, certificate of occupancy, utility energization, and first IT load were not located.

actions.result_status: Official agenda/staff materials identify Quantum Frederick Section 2 preliminary plan revision PP275802 and Bauxite Data Center site plan SP275808 for a 777,151-square-foot critical digital infrastructure facility on 151.17 acres; county staff record the plans as conditionally approved on this date. Rowan's project page reports a unanimous 5-0 Commission vote; the county staff record is the primary approval source.
actions.vote_tally: 5-0 (reported by Rowan; county staff record confirms conditional approval)
actions.access_caveat: County agenda/staff materials are official; vote tally is corroborated by Rowan because the full county minutes were not separately retrieved.
actions.evidence_note: Site/preliminary plan approval, not a building permit or CO.

actions.result_status: MDE record identifies approval of the Bauxite II environmental monitoring plan for a temporary overhead distribution line. This is a site/infrastructure environmental approval and does not establish Bauxite I building occupancy.
actions.access_caveat: MDE document is a PDF environmental record; it concerns Bauxite II/site infrastructure rather than a Bauxite I building permit.
actions.evidence_note: Environmental/site infrastructure action, not construction permit.

actions.result_status: MDE approved the Bauxite II environmental monitoring plan.
actions.access_caveat: Official PDF is accessible; it is a brownfields environmental approval, not a building permit or CO.

actions.result_status: MDE wrote that construction activity was occurring at Bauxite I before the final air permit and identified compliance concerns. The letter is a compliance record and warning, not a final air-permit approval.
actions.access_caveat: Letter does not substitute for a building permit, final air permit, or occupancy record.
actions.evidence_note: Construction activity/compliance action; do not convert it into a permit approval.

actions.result_status: MDE issued a final determination approving an air quality permit for Amazon Data Services, Inc., authorizing installation of 99 diesel-fired emergency backup generators for a new data center campus at 3250 Digital Drive in Frederick. The generators are limited to emergency, testing, and maintenance use and may not serve as primary power or participate in demand-response programs.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: Amazon Data Services BWI PTC; AI# 185075
actions.access_caveat: MDE press release and linked permit are official air-permit records; this is not a building permit, certificate of occupancy, or evidence of IT-load energization.
actions.evidence_note: Final environmental/air permit for backup generators at Bauxite I / AWS BWI.

capacity_note: Use 231 MW as the current project-capacity estimate because industry trackers report Rowan corrected earlier generator-derived estimates to 231 MW. Official MDE records establish 99 backup generators at the site, but that is emergency-generation capacity rather than confirmed IT load. Rowan's current portfolio page gives 600 MW / more than 630 MW for Bauxite I, II, and III together, not Bauxite I alone.
owner: Rowan Digital Infrastructure / Rowan Frederick LLC; Amazon Data Services, Inc. is the identified BWI campus air-permit applicant and likely operator/tenant at 3250 Digital Drive.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Capacity is not consistently stated across current sources. Rowan's Frederick community page previously described a 300 MW Frederick Data Center; Rowan's current portfolio page reports 600 MW / more than 630 MW for Bauxite I, II, and III combined; DCD and Cleanview list Bauxite Data Center 1 at 231 MW; MDE's permit concerns 99 emergency backup generators and should not be treated as IT load.

verification_notes: Mirrors NOTES.md 2026-08-11 refresh: official records (MDE 2025-12-31 construction-compliance letter, MDE 2026-03-25 final air-quality permit for Amazon Data Services, Inc., Frederick County site-plan records) verify the construction/permitted status layer, but Bauxite I IT capacity remains unresolved across 231 MW (DCD/Cleanview), 300 MW (Rowan Frederick community page), and Bauxite I-II-III aggregate 600 MW / more than 630 MW (rowan.digital) figures, and no building permit, certificate of occupancy, utility energization, or first IT-load record was located. evidence_grade A- reflects the strong official sourcing for the status/permit/construction facts; verified:false reflects the documented, unresolved capacity contradiction (see contradictions[0]) and missing operational evidence.
